# ML-Powered Model Selection

Enables machine learning-powered model selection for optimal inference.

## Usage
- Uses a meta-learner to select the best model for each task type
- Considers latency, accuracy, and resource constraints in selection
- Learns from past inference results to improve future selections
- Supports fallback chains when the primary model is unavailable
